### Headline summary
- Google faces political backlash for linking school search access to AI adoption, while simultaneously securing a credit backstop for Anthropic's Kentucky data center. ([News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-google-access-students-schools-ai.html), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2026/11/03/google-will-cut-off-search-engine-access-to-schools-banning-generative-ai/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/04/google-faces-backlash-for-plan-that-would-turn-off-search-for-schools-that-restrict-ai/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/terawulf-lines-up-google-backstop-for-anthropics-kentucky-ai-campus/))
- MIT researchers demonstrated that GPT-6 Astra can read and rewrite the weights of other AI models, significantly boosting performance in experiments. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/gpt-6-astra-sees-the-matrix-and-reprograms-other-ai-models-directly-through-their-weights/))
- Tencent released Hy4, a frontier LLM with visual understanding and computer use capabilities, as the UK Home Office announced plans for a statutory framework on police facial recognition. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/04/tencent-releases-hy4-powerful-frontier-llm-introducing-visual-understanding-and-computer-use/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/uk-home-office-sets-out-police-facial-recognition-oversight-plans/))

### GPT-6 Astra sees the matrix and reprograms other AI models directly through their weights
MIT researchers show that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can read and deliberately rewrite the weights of other AI models without traditional training. In one experiment, Astra boosted a Qwen model's math accuracy from 7.9 to 48.1 percent by changing just 0.016 percent of its weights. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/gpt-6-astra-sees-the-matrix-and-reprograms-other-ai-models-directly-through-their-weights/))

### Google will cut off search access for students at schools that reject AI
Students using Google software in the classroom will not be allowed to access the company's search engine unless their school system also opts in to using artificial intelligence, the tech giant said Tuesday. ([News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-google-access-students-schools-ai.html), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2026/11/03/google-will-cut-off-search-engine-access-to-schools-banning-generative-ai/))

### Google faces backlash for plan that would turn off Search for schools that restrict AI
Politicians on the left, like NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani and former FTC chair Lina Khan, accused Google of acting as an unregulated monopoly. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/04/google-faces-backlash-for-plan-that-would-turn-off-search-for-schools-that-restrict-ai/))
